text:
Maya: Quick check — planning to enable `quant.precision.int4` for a 10% canary tomorrow 09:00 PT across hosted + dedicated for our low-latency cohort. Want to surface perf/regression guardrails before we flip.

Sam: Can you paste the exact flag name + cohort selector? also need recent perf numbers (p50/p95 tokens/ms) and GPU mem delta.

Maya: Flag: `flags/quant/precision/int4_enabled`
Cohort: `cohort=beta_internal || org_tag=alpha` (internal+alpha customers), scope=gen endpoints only (no embeddings).
Quick perf: local int4 QA run (seq_len=512): p50 token latency -8ms, p95 +6ms, throughput +18%. GPU memory -22% vs fp16. These are on A10x.

Ian: Important: add eval guardrails. We require: eval.delta_qa_accuracy <= 0.02, hallucination rate delta <= 0.01 absolute, rouge/bleu regression < threshold. Also runtime guard: p95 latency increase < 10ms and error_rate < 0.5% during canary window. If any fail, auto rollback.

Anita: Also please exclude embeddings + reranking routes from this toggle. We have had customers sensitive to numeric drift there. Update the rollout config in `infra/feature-flags/rollouts/quant-int4.yaml`. Example snippet: 
```yaml
flag: flags/quant/precision/int4_enabled
percent: 10
scope: ["gen_v1", "gen_v2"]
exclude_tags: ["enterprise", "embeddings"]
rollout_schedule: "2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00"
guardrails:
  - eval_score_delta: 0.02
  - p95_latency_ms: 10
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
```

Raj: I'll open the PR for the rollout config + runtime guard hooks (RBAC + rollback webhooks). Ping me for code review: PR #7892. Also adding fallback path: on any OOM or kv-cache mismatch we serve fp16 variant via routing policy `route.fallback=fp16`.

Sam: Can you attach the eval result links and the load test artifact? I want to eyeball token distribution. Also we need a smoke deploy to staging with 1% first.

Maya: Attaching links in PR, + loadtest id `lt-20260315-42`. Good call on 1% ramp: plan = 1% -> 10% after 30m -> 25% after 2h -> 100% after 24h if clean.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: id `rollout-20260315-1772501234`, start=2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00, plan=[1%,10%,25%,100%]. Metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/rollout-20260315-1772501234

Sam: I'll watch the dashboard during the first 2 hours. @Ian can you add the eval regression alert to the rollout job?

Ian: On it. I'll wire the alert to Slack channel `#eng-oncall` and set severity P1 for hallucination delta > 0.01 or error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

Anita: One more: exclude dedicated customers because some have pinned kernels. I'll add a `exclude_org_tags: ["dedicated-enterprise"]` entry.

Maya: @Anita thanks — please add that to the PR. @Raj please include the rollback ops runbook in the PR description (steps, who to ping, quick commands).

Raj: Will do. Quick monitor commands for oncall: 
`kubectl logs -f deploy/model-serving -l rollout=rollout-20260315-1772501234 | grep ERROR`
`curl https://metrics.redwood/api/rollouts/rollout-20260315-1772501234/summary`
If error_rate > 1% -> `flags client toggle flags/quant/precision/int4_enabled false --env=prod`

Maya: Who's on first-watch?

Sam: I can take the 09:00-11:00 PT window. Will drop notes in #eng-oncall.

Anita: Added PR comment with exclude list and updated yaml.

Raj: PR #7892 is ready for review, ops runbook added.

Sam: LGTM, will watch live. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks everyone. Will proceed with staged rollout tomorrow. If anything changes I'll update here. :rocket:
